title: SMS Delivery Failures from Twilio to Telemat Cel Brazil
impact_summary: SMS delivery to Telemat Cel network subscribers in Brazil has experienced failures, though recovery is underway.
backbase_rationale: Backbase services remain unaffected; monitoring the situation is adequate.

title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to Free Caraibe Martinique
impact_summary: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery delays from Twilio to Free Caraibe network subscribers in Martinique. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 1 hour or as soon as more information becomes available.
backbase_rationale: The delays could impact timely message delivery for Backbase clients.

title: Update to SendGrid Domain Authentication: Send to Coworker Action Removed
impact_summary: The Send to Coworker action has been removed from the domain authentication flow, requiring users to use alternative internal communication channels for DNS record updates.
backbase_rationale: Ensures compliance with updated security practices and reduces risk of DNS misconfiguration.

title: Jumio Android SDK v4.18.0
impact_summary: The SDK now requires a minimum Android API level of 24 (Nougat), which may break builds on older devices.
backbase_rationale: Backbase must modify its Android code to target API 24 or higher to ensure compatibility with the updated SDK.

title: Jumio Android SDK v4.14.0
impact_summary: Accessibility updates align the SDK with WCAG 2.2 AA and EAA compliance, requiring validation for current apps.
backbase_rationale: Backbase should assess its implementation to ensure compliance with the new accessibility requirements.

title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to Free Caraibe France
impact_summary: Users may be experiencing delays in SMS delivery to Free Caraibe network subscribers in France, with root cause identified.
backbase_rationale: Issue identified and being resolved; Backbase requires only monitoring.

title: SMS Delivery Failures from Twilio to Lycamobile United Kingdom
impact_summary: SMS delivery to Lycamobile network subscribers in the United Kingdom has seen intermittent failures, but a recovery trend is observed.
backbase_rationale: No immediate impact on Backbase services; continued monitoring is sufficient.
